## EKI Risk Check

- [ ] Data Privacy - Client-confidential, private/sensitive data is absent, redacted, or appropriate for this repository's visibility and reviewers.
- [ ] Cybersecurity - No secrets, tokens, keys, passwords, or connection strings are committed.
- [ ] Downstream impacts - GitHub Actions, automation, deployment, hosting, database, and IT needs are called out.
- [ ] AI/LLM-assisted work has been reviewed for privacy, data handling, and accuracy concerns, if applicable.
- [ ] Application inventory metadata is updated or not applicable.
